core-kind: Both members are closed serde enums in the same folder with the same derive line and doc habit as the status cluster; core-status-pattern already teaches this role on the identical paths glob.
core-source: The cluster declares only one type, SavingsSource in economy/model.rs; writer.rs merely consumes it, so there is no repeated shape to teach.
dashboard-row: Covered by dashboard-use-pattern: the fan-out result interfaces live in src/hooks and are documented there as part of the useQueries convention.
dashboard-source: Same role as dashboard-kind-pattern: the exemplars are the src/lib/types wire-mirror files that mold already teaches.
dashboard-summary: No distinct shape: both exemplars are ordinary src/hooks/use*.ts query hooks already taught in full by dashboard-use-pattern.
dashboard-wave: Same role as dashboard-kind-pattern: WaveCost/SpecWave/WaveChild are snake_case DTO mirrors in the same two files; a per-suffix mold would fragment one convention into three.
rt-file: The two members share only the word file: ChangedFile is a parsed git diff row in diff_digest.rs, while wave_done.rs declares no *File type at all — its hits are prose in a Files section. No recurring shape to teach.
scan-cli: Phantom affix: Cli is a single declaration (the clap root struct in main.rs); the other matches are token folds. Same paths and exemplars as scan-src, whose How to apply already covers adding a subcommand.
